steps.message: I will use Azure Resource Lookup.

arguments.command: az graph query -q "Resources | where type =~ 'microsoft.compute/disks' and isempty(managedBy) and isempty(managedByExtended)" --subscriptions 22222222-2222-2222-2222-222222222222

results.content: disk-old-01 rg-legacy; disk-test-02 rg-test; managedBy empty; managedByExtended empty.

steps.message: Azure Resource Graph found two managed disks whose managedBy field is empty: disk-old-01 in rg-legacy and disk-test-02 in rg-test. This is a read-only inventory result, not approval to delete them.
